_about: Hand-written per-building specs from looking at photos (research-arch). Merged over the base layer by tools/arch/extract.py. confidence: photo = facade seen in a street-level photo; aerial = roof/massing/colour seen in a drone photo (facade detail partly inferred). 'parts' = sub-volumes when one OSM footprint holds several real buildings (pos 0..1 along the footprint's longest axis from its west/north end).

facade.baseNote: terracotta brick tile ring round the big arch

balconies.note: first floor is a terrace across the whole front behind a white classical balustrade with turned balusters (top at ~5.7 m); the upper storey is set back ~2.5 m behind it with dark metal-and-glass screens

w1075949216.name: Kifisias 236 arcade block (Platanos)

w1075949216.notes: Kifisias 236 (OPAP, Platanos cafe, Coffeeway, Mela shop listing). Seen at the bottom right of the drone view r09: multi-hip terracotta roofs around a glazed skylight passage, colonnade at ground level.

w1075952145.name: KFC arcade block (Kifisias Ave at Platanos)
w1075952145.notes: Mela arcade, Kifisias Ave 238 (KFC; former Grand Hotel de Kifissia, 1897, per research-shops text). The drone view r09 shows this footprint as a long arcade building under one low hipped terracotta roof with a deep colonnade of square cream pillars and cafe terraces. No 3-storey neoclassical facade is visible on it from the air. Build the massing from the aerial; detail the facade as restrained neoclassical (cream render, moulded cornice) until a street photo exists.

w1086751869.name: International School of Athens - main building

facade.baseNote: low stone plinth with semi-basement windows, garden wall with iron railing

balconies.note: small black wrought-iron balconies under every first- and second-floor window; wider balcony in the central bay and on the corner bays

w1086751869.notes: West facade from a reference-only photo (lm-isa). The 1928 postcard shows the hotel in rough stone; today it is rendered cream-white.

w1076768346.name: Kassaveti tower arcade (Πύργος Κασσαβέτη)

facade.note: red-brown face brick in stretcher bond everywhere; thin pale-green/grey metal fascia bands over the shop row and over the first-floor gallery

balconies.note: first floor is a recessed gallery/loggia with black iron railing on a brick parapet; timber-framed shop windows behind; second floor a solid brick band

source: research-shops (ORDERS 2026-11-21: 'b423 is a modern brick shopping arcade')
commons:File:Οικία Κότσικα, Κηφισιά 0934.jpg (C messier, CC BY-SA 4.0) (right edge of the photo, the brick building east of the villa)

w1072202922.name: Ruined stone mansion by the station (OSM building=ruins)

facade.note: weathered grey rubble-stone walls with lighter dressed-stone quoins and window surrounds; patches of lost render

source: commons:File:Κηφισιά 4110.jpg (C messier, CC BY-SA 4.0, drone view over Kifisia station looking ENE); identified as the only building between Tatoiou and the rail cutting south of the station, matching the OSM ruins tag
w1072202922.roofDetail: none: roofless ruin, walls end at ragged parapet height, interior open to the sky

w1072358338.name: White stepped apartment block, Grigoriou Lampraki (facing the rail)

balconies.note: deep wrap-around balconies on every floor, solid white parapets, grey/white roller awnings; facade stepped (saw-tooth) in plan towards the street

source: commons:File:Κηφισιά 4110.jpg (C messier, CC BY-SA 4.0, drone view over Kifisia station looking ENE); id by position (the stepped block east of Gr. Lampraki opposite the platforms)

w1072358339.name: Hip-roofed house south of the stepped block
source: commons:File:Κηφισιά 4110.jpg (C messier, CC BY-SA 4.0, drone view over Kifisia station looking ENE); id by position (moderate certainty: the hip-roofed house right below the stepped block)

w1077113199.name: Kolokotroni 11 corner block (Vagenas, Agora Deco&Deli)

facade.note: cream render; strong horizontal solid parapet bands on each upper floor

balconies.note: solid cream parapets, partly recessed loggias with dark window walls behind

source: commons:File:Οδός Κολοκοτρώνη, Κηφισιά 0907.jpg (C messier, CC BY-SA 4.0); id by position: the block with the rounded east end straight ahead of the camera looking west along Kolokotroni (footprint has the round east corners); partly hidden by plane trees

w302682638.name: Retsinas Mansion = Goulandris Natural History Museum, Levidou 13

facade.baseNote: plinth / forecourt wall of polygonal (cyclopean) grey-ochre stone with a white marble coping and black iron railings between square white piers

balconies.note: single-storey front wing with a flat roof terrace edged by a black iron railing; small corner terraces with iron rails on the main block

w302682638.notes: Main block 2 storeys with a hip-and-gable tiled roof; the front single-storey wing projects towards Levidou. Footprint 1087 m2 includes the wings; the visible main block is ~9 bays wide.

w1073120660.name: Kokkotas House (Οικία Κόκκοτα), Kokota street — half-timbered villa with two spired corner turrets

facade.note: ground floor of grey-brown rubble stone; upper floor white render with orange-red painted timber framing (posts, rails and St Andrew's crosses) and an orange-red band at floor level

balconies.note: one timber balcony with red-brown boarded balustrade over the central entrance bay

source: osm footprint (east side has the two round turret bumps and the central bay)
commons:File:Οικία Κόκκοτα 3, Κηφισιά DJI 4117.jpg and DJI 4115.jpg (C messier, CC BY-SA 4.0, drone); id by camera geotag on Kokota street (-153,-102) + footprint shape
w1073120660.notes: Front (turrets, entrance, garden) faces EAST onto Kokota street. Neighbours seen: white 3-storey hip-roofed blocks to the south, a house with an octagonal grey turret roof to the north.

w1077110409.name: Perrakis House (Οικία Περράκη), Kolokotroni — SkourasMed

facade.baseNote: raised semi-basement in render with small windows; white corner pilasters, white window surrounds

balconies.note: central recessed porch/veranda under the front gable: red-brown painted timber posts, pierced fretwork balustrade panels and lace-like brackets

source: osm footprint (south edge has the projecting central porch + stair)
commons:File:Οικία Περράκη, Κηφισσιά 0914.jpg (C messier, CC BY-SA 4.0); id by camera geotag (284,13) looking north at the nearest footprint
w1077110409.notes: Front faces SOUTH towards Kolokotroni / the pedestrian square, ~13 m wide, symmetric: porch in the middle, one tall window each side.

w262269079.name: National Bank of Greece, Platanos square (star-plan modern building)

facade.note: white/very light grey stone or panel cladding, crisp volumes; the plan is a square with chamfered, projecting full-height bays on the corners/sides (OSM footprint is the star)

source: commons:File:Κηφισιά 4102.jpg (C messier, CC BY-SA 4.0, drone over Platanos square); footprint matched in the fitted overlay docs/research/img/arch/r09_platanos_footprint_overlay_CCBYSA.jpg
orthophoto: flat light roof with central pyramid
w262269079.notes: Seen only from above at an angle: storey count from the glazed bay height (~3 floors). Ground floor shop units per shops.json groundFloor (crêperie etc.).

w1075948790.roofDetail: low hip roof of grey-green sheet (painted metal or patinated copper), central ridge; seen in the orthophoto
source: orthophoto (Ktimatologio c.2007-2010): grey-green hip roof, misread as flat by the colour classifier; corrected by eye

w1076626153.name: Πύργος Κηφισιάς (Kifisia Tower) — corner Kassaveti / Kyriazi, Zara
w1076626153.roofDetail: one large hip roof of terracotta tiles over the whole block around a central rectangular glazed atrium skylight (metal frame); at the rounded NW corner facing the spawn junction a round corner tower rises above the eaves and ends in a light grey hemispherical dome

parts.note: the footprint's rounded NW corner (vertices 101.5..108.1, 72.6..78) is the tower

source: orthophoto (Ktimatologio c.2007-2010): hip roof, atrium, round corner tower with dome — docs/research/img/arch/ortho_kassaveti_roofclass_REFONLY.jpg
w1076626153.notes: Facade not yet photo-checked: storeys (4) and facade colours are class inferences. The domed corner tower is the landmark of the junction's SE corner.
